_comment: Scanner-owned. Overwritten each weekday after post-market close by the site-manager scan. Same shape as guide.json, plus asOf (YYYY-MM-DD). Never edit guide.json from the scanner — curated data wins every collision (theme ids and company records). Tickers here may reference companies defined in guide.json; add a company record below only for names the curated guide doesn't cover.

themes.name: 1-week gainers
themes.blurb: US common names whose close peaked at least 30% above the window-start close in 1 week, with 20-day ADR at least 3% and 20-day average dollar volume at least $100M.

themes.name: 1-month gainers
themes.blurb: US common names whose close peaked at least 30% above the window-start close in 1 month, with 20-day ADR at least 3% and 20-day average dollar volume at least $100M.

themes.name: 3-month gainers
themes.blurb: US common names whose close peaked at least 30% above the window-start close in 3 months, with 20-day ADR at least 3% and 20-day average dollar volume at least $100M.

themes.name: 6-month gainers
themes.blurb: US common names whose close peaked at least 30% above the window-start close in 6 months, with 20-day ADR at least 3% and 20-day average dollar volume at least $100M.
